headline: Fresh Strongpoint Events Hit Weathered Expanse, Mooring and Godcrofts
war_summary: Since the last bulletin, strongpoint fighting has returned to several quiet sectors. Weathered Expanse, idle in the preceding two-hour count, has logged five fresh events in the latest interval and stands among the most heavily worked fronts of the war. Mooring County, also silent in the earlier count, added three events; Fisherman's Row, easing from its morning rush, reported two more. Godcrofts has shown renewed activity as well. Stlican Shelf recorded further changes before lapsing quiet in the final two hours; its nine posts now divide six Warden to three Colonial. Farranac Coast and LinnMercy have gone quiet at the base level, while Stonecradle has seen no fresh turns in the last six hours despite heavy casualties. Callahans Passage reports sharply accelerating losses without a recent recorded change of ownership, and Nevish Line has carried heavy day-long fighting without a turnover. No side holds the thirty-four victory towns required, and the war remains undecided.
